_meta.purpose: Worker A consolidation decision overlay; preserves immutable batch research and master queue
_meta.important_limit: Narrow review list is a rule-based, manually curated triage from research flags, not a proof that other entries have perfect coordinates. Individual source site verification remains incomplete.

decision_policy.recency: Do not require a confirmed physical sexual encounter. Keep separate recent discussions, dated questions, self check-ins, firsthand accounts, older listings and negative reports; no negative conclusion from absent data.
decision_policy.public_shared_spaces: Informational context only; not a categorical disqualification.
decision_policy.general_access_and_safety: Informational context only unless an explicit current closure makes normal public entry unavailable.
decision_policy.old_information: Combine with recency/conflict review, rather than treating age alone as a separate blocker.
decision_policy.technical_source_pages: Retain source links and inaccessible/blocked statuses; lack of access is not proof of no location.
